title: GB5 PM Runbook
subtitle: La Marzocco GB5 S | preventive maintenance kits and steps
sources: La Marzocco USA preventative maintenance checklists v2.1 (May 2026): 3/9-month, 6-month and 12-month. Kit numbers are per visit and group count. La Marzocco does not print kit contents on the checklists; where a kit note lists contents it comes from the checklist's replace list or LM's annual PM summary. Confirm kit numbers with La Marzocco USA before ordering. GB5 S kit contents: LM GB5 S PM summary v1.0 (Mar 2021).

banners.text: One kit per visit. The 3/9-month PM is the same visit at month 3 and month 9; the 6- and 12-month kits are complete for their visit, so earlier kits are not added.
La Marzocco publishes this checklist for the GB5 S. For an original GB5, confirm the kit with La Marzocco before ordering.

items.text: Test the water before and after the filter with the LM test kit (F.9.000.01). Record the filter make and type and compare with the limits in Reference.
Fit the parts in the PM kit: group gaskets and diffuser screens on every group, plus the visit's other parts (see Kits).
Check the filter baskets and springs.
Test every button.
Measure each flow meter's field resistance: 2.2 kΩ ±10% (1.98–2.42 kΩ). Record G1–G4 in kΩ.
Check the flow meter impellers.
Record each group's flow rate: grams in 30 s, G1–G4.
Record the brewing pressure (bar).
Check the expansion valve and record its maximum pressure (bar).
Record the coffee boiler temperature (°F).
Check the vacuum breakers work.
Rebuild the steam valves (in the kit).
Check the steam valves work.
Clean the auto-fill probe.
Check all fittings and valves for leaks.
Check the water line and water meter for leaks.
Check the drain box and hose for leaks or clogs.
Check the power cord, cap and outlet.
Check the wiring harness and components.
Check the electronics box.
Confirm or calibrate the integrated scales with a 100 g weight.
Fill in the La Marzocco checklist for this visit: serial, voltage, group count and every reading. Get the customer's signature.

reference.title: Water limits (LM test kit F.9.000.01)
reference.text: Test before and after the filter. Record the filter make and type: carbon, ion exchange/softener, WAC, reverse osmosis, or none.

reference.title: Specs on the checklists
list: Flow meter field resistance: 2.2 kΩ ±10% (1.98–2.42 kΩ).
Flow rate: the checklist header says ml/30 s but the blanks say g. Record grams in 30 s and note it.
Brew pressure, expansion valve max pressure and boiler temperature: the checklists give blanks, no targets. Use the machine manual's settings.
Integrated scales: confirm or calibrate with a 100 g weight.
